name: agent-widgets
description: Native macOS desktop widgets built by Claude: ready-made widgets, previews with layout checks, signed builds and shots of the real desktop.
long_description:
Ask for a widget and get a real one on the macOS desktop. The gallery has AI limits for Claude and Codex, running agent sessions, GitHub contributions, AI spend, 2048, a system monitor and a focus timer; anything else is written as a small SwiftUI view and a feed script. The server renders every size in light, dark, idle and clear glass, checks overflow, truncation and empty space, then builds, signs, installs and captures the widget on the desktop.

Needs macOS 14+, Xcode 16+ with a free Apple ID (Personal Team) and `brew install xcodegen`. Pick any folder for your widgets — an empty one is fine, the aw_init tool sets it up.
